title: Libby preclinical-evidence row
description: Row per pre-clinical literature finding. Appended by researcher agent.

inclusion_status.description: Did this paper enter the synthesis fed to the tumor board (`included`), or was it reviewed and excluded (`considered_excluded`)? The master manuscripts page renders both.

exclusion_reason.description: Required when `inclusion_status: considered_excluded`. Brief reason — e.g. 'in-vitro only, no in-vivo data', 'tumor type unrelated', 'mechanism diverges from intervention'.

n_units.description: Sample size / replicates as published (e.g. 'n=8 mice/arm', 'n=3 biological replicates').

control_arm.description: Control comparator used in the study.

dose_and_schedule.description: Dosing as published (e.g. '10 mg/kg IP q3d × 4 weeks').

case_match.description: How well does the model system match the patient's tumor / biomarker profile?
